components.name: Layer Name
components.description: A display name for the layer.

components.name: Initial Visibility
components.description: Whether the layer is on initially.

components.name: Initial Opacity
components.description: A value from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque) of the layer's initial opacity.

rows.name: Source
rows.subdescription: A heatmap layer does not load its own data. It renders a density heatmap of the features currently loaded by another vector layer in this mission (2D Map only).

components.name: Source Layer
components.description: (Required) The Layer Name of an existing vector layer in this mission whose features feed this heatmap. Points are weighted directly; lines and polygons are sampled into points.

components.name: Weight Property
components.description: Optional numeric feature property used as each sample's intensity weight. Leave blank for a weight of 1.

components.name: Weight Min
components.description: Optional. Weights are clamped to this minimum and, together with Weight Max, normalized to 0-1.

components.name: Weight Max
components.description: Optional. Weights are clamped to this maximum and, together with Weight Min, normalized to 0-1.

components.name: Line Sample Spacing (m)
components.description: Distance in meters between sample points along LineStrings and Polygon boundaries/interiors. Default 5.

components.name: Radius
components.description: Radius of influence of each sample. Default 25.

components.name: Radius Units
components.description: 'px' keeps a constant screen-pixel radius across zooms. 'm' converts meters to pixels using the map's CRS resolution at the current zoom.

components.name: Blur (px)
components.description: Blur applied to each sample's stamp. Default 15.

components.name: Max Intensity
components.description: Summed weight at which the heatmap saturates to the top gradient color. Default 1.

components.name: Gradient
components.description: JSON object of gradient stops (0-1) to CSS colors. Default {"0.4":"blue","0.65":"lime","1":"red"}
